required_manual_checks.description: Define 'high-priority prospect' using only data that exists today (stage, due and overdue follow-ups, last contact, assignment, existing assessment fields), since website detection and quality scoring come later. State the ranking rule, its tie-breaks, where it is surfaced, and how the later website-quality score slots in without a redesign.

Specify one partner-friendly pipeline that unifies the current /sales queue, /sales/list browse and prospect detail, removes dead-end screens and duplicate paths, and keeps Sales partner capabilities exactly as authorized (prospects:write, not prospects:manage).

Inventory every notes store (prospects.notes, prospect_notes log from 008, contact notes from 010) and specify how notes appear directly on prospect and client screens and how Sales, Production and other engines read them. Identify any schema or authorization change this implies as a separate human decision.
Map the current promote path (route, vault writes, events, what carries over) and specify a smoother prospect-to-client transition, including what history and notes follow the client.

State plainly what is live: the production ledger is at 009 and 010_sales_actions.sql is not applied, so the promoted 2A.2 Sales UI is not usable in production. List the migration, backup/recovery re-proof and deployment decision required before or alongside 2A.3, without performing any of it.
Split 2A.3 into implementation tasks, each with write paths, gates, visual and accessibility proof at the six 1C viewports, and owner decisions. Keep each small enough for one review round.
Diff contains only apps/os/docs/SLICE-2A3-PREFLIGHT.md. No code, migration, production access or deployment.
